description.value:
Centered on a point within range, a 30-foot-radius pulse scrambles the targeting systems of every droid or construct caught in it. Each must attempt an Intelligence saving throw; a Piloted construct with a conscious pilot adds that pilot's Intelligence modifier to the roll. On a failure, the target can no longer tell friend from foe and treats every creature it can see as a threat until the power ends, though it may retry the save whenever it takes damage.

While affected, the creature must choose its targets at random among those it can see, and it is compelled to make any opportunity attack it is able to make.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 5
